ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 2, 3 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

No website draft existed for the opening thought, which is translated fresh. «Благо» (blago) is 'the good' and «добро» (dobro) 'good'; where Marcus Aurelius pairs them («благо и добро для всех») the English keeps both.
